semantics.clock: All state updates on positive edge of clk
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset; q becomes 0 on any positive edge with reset asserted, with priority over counting
semantics.transition: At each positive edge without reset, q becomes 0 if previous q was 999, otherwise previous q plus 1
semantics.period: 1000 non-reset clock cycles, visiting 0 through 999 inclusive
semantics.between_edges: q holds its value, including when reset changes between edges
semantics.initialization: Power-up state is unspecified; valid count sequence is established by a sampled reset

numeric.illegal_initial_state: No additional recovery behavior required for states 1000 through 1023 before reset

verification.oracle: Independent integer count modulo 1000, updated at each rising edge after reset initializes it
checks: Reset at clock edge sets zero
Reset held across multiple edges holds zero
Increment and exact wrap over at least three complete periods
Reset during counting and at terminal count takes priority
Reset assertion/deassertion between rising edges cannot change q
Check q after nonblocking updates and verify stable output between edges
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; compile and simulation each bounded by timeout
verification.initial_state: Do not assert any value before the first sampled reset

specification_ambiguities: Power-up value before synchronous reset is not specified; no initialization is added.
